en_title: 'We Are a Little Bit Masochistic' — Developers Are Running Scared of Baldur's Gate 4, but Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader Studio Owlcat Would Consider It a 'Great Challenge'
cn_title: 《博德之门4》吓退开发者，Owlcat称会考虑这项「巨大挑战」
subtitle: 不做Larian翻版
opus_summary: Larian放弃《博德之门4》后，Owlcat称若受邀会把开发该作视为「巨大挑战」，但不会复制Larian模式。前《博德之门2》主设计师James Ohlen则因担心无法竞争而拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Baldur’s Gate 4 appears to have developers running scared because they’re worried about meeting expectations set by Larian’s Baldur’s Gate 3 . But one developer has said they would consider making the game a “great challenge” — although they’d avoid simply replicating what had gone before.
paragraphs.cn: 《博德之门4》似乎吓退了开发者，因为他们担心无法达到Larian《博德之门3》树立的期望。不过有一家开发商表示，会将制作这款游戏视为「巨大挑战」——但会避免简单照搬此前的做法。

paragraphs.en: After Larian decided against making Baldur’s Gate 4 and left Dungeons & Dragons behind to work on Divinity , fans have wondered which studio might be capable of taking on perhaps the toughest sequel in all video games. Among the studios that are often mentioned in online debates about who to turn to is Owlcat Games.
paragraphs.cn: Larian决定不制作《博德之门4》，告别《龙与地下城》转而开发《神界》后，粉丝一直在猜测：哪家工作室或许有能力接手这款可能是整个游戏界最难开发的续作。在网上关于该找谁的讨论中，Owlcat Games经常被提及。

paragraphs.en: Owlcat is the developer of a number of well-received role-playing games including cRPG Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader , which was compared to Baldur’s Gate 3 upon its 2023 release. Rogue Trader is considered one of the best Warhammer 40,000 video games ever made, with fantastic characters, a gripping story, and over 100 hours of content — just like Baldur’s Gate 3.
paragraphs.cn: Owlcat开发过多款广受好评的角色扮演游戏，包括2023年发售时曾被拿来与《博德之门3》比较的cRPG《战锤40K：行商浪人》(Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader)。《行商浪人》被认为是史上最优秀的《战锤40K》(Warhammer 40,000)游戏之一，拥有出色的角色、扣人心弦的剧情以及超过100小时的内容——就像《博德之门3》一样。

paragraphs.en: While it didn’t quite reach the heights of Baldur’s Gate 3, Rogue Trader did well enough for Owlcat to secure a follow-up, Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy , which has many fans not just of Games Workshop’s grimdark setting on high alert, but cRPG fans rubbing their hands in anticipation.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管《行商浪人》未能达到《博德之门3》的高度，但成绩已足以让Owlcat获得后续项目《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》。这不仅让Games Workshop黑暗科幻设定的许多粉丝严阵以待，也让cRPG爱好者搓手期待。

paragraphs.en: So, would Owlcat answer the call, if Hasbro were to pick up the phone and ask it to make Baldur’s Gate 4? That’s the question I put to co-founder and creative director Alexander Mishulin, and… well, he didn’t say no!
paragraphs.cn: 那么，如果孩之宝打来电话，请Owlcat制作《博德之门4》，它会响应召唤吗？这是我向联合创始人兼创意总监Alexander Mishulin提出的问题，而……嗯，他没有说不！

paragraphs.en: “First of all, I would like to thank all the players, all your audience that consider us to be able to do that,” he began, diplomatically. “It's a really great honor. You already said that we are a little bit masochistic. So yeah, we will consider it a great challenge!”
paragraphs.cn: 他圆融地开场道：「首先，我想感谢所有认为我们有能力做到这件事的玩家，以及你们所有读者。这真的是极大的荣幸。你已经说过，我们有点受虐倾向。所以，没错，我们会把它视为巨大挑战！」

paragraphs.en: Indeed I had said Owlcat was masochistic — for taking on the challenge of making Warhammer 40,000 games and a The Expanse game ( we’ve got an exclusive reveal on The Expanse right here ), as part of a wide-ranging interview in which we discuss Owlcat's enormous growth over the last decade . The Warhammer 40,000 and The Expanse universes each has a hardcore fanbase that puts any adaptation under intense scrutiny, but Owlcat is very much up for meeting player expectations, which is why Baldur’s Gate 4 might be a great fit.
paragraphs.cn: 我确实说过Owlcat有点受虐——毕竟它敢于接受开发《战锤40K》(Warhammer 40,000)游戏和一款《苍穹浩瀚》游戏的挑战（我们已在这里独家揭晓《苍穹浩瀚》相关消息）。这是我们一次广泛访谈的一部分，访谈中讨论了Owlcat过去十年的巨大成长。《战锤40K》(Warhammer 40,000)和《苍穹浩瀚》宇宙各自都有硬核粉丝群体，会严密审视任何改编作品；但Owlcat非常愿意满足玩家期望，这也是《博德之门4》或许很适合它的原因。

paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that Mishulin is not confirming anything here, but understands what taking on Baldur's Gate 4 would involve, and the challenge Owlcat would face were matching the standards set by its predecessor. But, he suggests, that’s fine, because any developer simply trying to replicate a Larian game would be doomed to fail.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，Mishulin并未在此确认任何事，但他明白接手《博德之门4》意味着什么，也明白Owlcat若要达到前作树立的标准将面临何种挑战。不过他表示，这没有问题，因为任何只想复制一款Larian游戏的开发商都注定失败。

paragraphs.en: “In my opinion, Larian has made their own vision of how a sequel to Baldurs's Gate should be, and they presented it to us. Any other studio that will be doing BG4 will be doing their own game in the Baldurs' Gate setting,” he explained. “It will not be Larian's BG3, because BG3 is very Larian formula, with all their ideas for combat and how they mix with Dungeons & Dragons, with their idea of the co-op experience and how it plays into the Dungeons & Dragons experience. So any studio that would be trying to replicate that is bound to fail. It’s just not the way it works. Larian were making such games for 20 years, 30 years right now, starting from the first Divinity. It's their view of the games, it's their view of RPGs, and it's a great game.
paragraphs.cn: 「在我看来，Larian已经做出了他们认为《博德之门》续作该有的样子，并把它呈现给了我们。任何制作《博德之门4》的其他工作室，都会制作一款以《博德之门》为背景、属于自己的游戏。」他解释道，「它不会是Larian的《博德之门3》，因为《博德之门3》完全是Larian式的公式，包含他们对战斗的所有构想、这些构想如何与《龙与地下城》融合、他们对合作体验的构想，以及合作体验如何融入《龙与地下城》体验。因此，任何试图复制这一点的工作室都注定失败。事情不是这么运转的。Larian从第一部《神界》开始，已经制作这类游戏20年、30年了。这是他们看待游戏的方式，是他们看待RPG的方式，而这是一款伟大的游戏。」

paragraphs.en: “But other studios will do something differently. They will have their own DNA, their own ideas, and they will pour them into Baldur’s Gate 4, and it will be something else. I hope that there will be a studio brave enough and passionate enough and skillful enough to do that game.”
paragraphs.cn: 「但其他工作室会做出不同的东西。它们会有自己的DNA、自己的想法，并将其注入《博德之门4》，它会成为另一种作品。我希望会有一家工作室足够勇敢、足够热忱、也足够有技术，来制作这款游戏。」

paragraphs.en: “Thank you!” Mishulin replied, with a smile.
Hasbro, which owns Dungeons & Dragons operator Wizards of the Coast, has insisted it intends to make Baldur's Gate 4 eventually. But it turns out developers are actually turning the project down.
paragraphs.cn: 拥有《龙与地下城》运营商威世智的孩之宝一直坚持称，最终会制作《博德之门4》。但事实证明，开发商实际上正拒绝这个项目。

paragraphs.en: PC Gamer recently spoke with James Ohlen, co-lead designer of Baldur’s Gate 2 and former boss of Hasbro-owned Exodus developer Archetype Entertainment, and he revealed that Hasbro had asked him to make Baldur’s Gate 4, but he said no. Ohlen told Hasbro boss Chris Cox, who had called him to ask about making Baldur’s Gate 4 as soon as he found out Larian wouldn't, that he “would fail.” Why? Because he didn’t think he could compete against Baldur’s Gate 3. “That would be insanity,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: PC Gamer最近采访了《博德之门2》联合主设计师、曾任孩之宝旗下《Exodus》开发商Archetype Entertainment负责人的James Ohlen。他透露，孩之宝曾请他制作《博德之门4》，但他拒绝了。Ohlen告诉孩之宝老板Chris Cox：Cox一得知Larian不会制作《博德之门4》就致电询问此事，而他「会失败」。为什么？因为他认为自己无法与《博德之门3》竞争。「那会是疯了，」他说。

paragraphs.en: Larian, which had years of experience making role-playing games with its own engine via the well-received and successful Divinity: Original Sin games before starting work on Baldur's Gate 3, put the game into Steam early access for years before its full launch in 2023. That long-running process and the invaluable feedback that came from it helped shape the game. But on top of that, the developers at Larian are just amazing at what they do, their writers are the best in the business, their quest designers the envy of the video game industry. Baldur’s Gate 3 is a masterpiece but it is also truly unique, with more content than any single player could ever hope to see. Most developers are not in the position to make a game like Baldur’s Gate 3. None, other than perhaps Rockstar, has the time, resources, or the freedom to make the sort of creative decisions that went into Baldur's Gate 3. Baldur’s Gate 3 is a single-player role-playing game that could last you forever, and truly, there are none in the modern era quite like it.
paragraphs.cn: Larian在着手开发《博德之门3》前，已通过广受好评且商业成功的《神界：原罪》系列，积累了多年使用自家引擎制作角色扮演游戏的经验。该工作室还在2023年正式发售前，让游戏在Steam抢先体验中运行了数年。这一漫长过程及其带来的宝贵反馈帮助塑造了游戏。除此之外，Larian的开发者本就极其出色：他们的编剧是业界顶尖，任务设计师也令游戏行业艳羡。《博德之门3》是一部杰作，也确实独一无二，内容多到任何单个玩家都不可能全部看到。大多数开发商都不具备制作《博德之门3》这类游戏的条件。除了或许Rockstar之外，没有谁拥有投入《博德之门3》那种创意决策所需的时间、资源或自由度。《博德之门3》是一款能让你玩很久的单人角色扮演游戏，而在当代，确实没有其他作品能与之相似。

paragraphs.en: How do you follow Baldur’s Gate 3, then? Ohlen, clearly, couldn’t see a path forward. He said he’d need to start from scratch, because Larian has walked away from Dungeons & Dragons and taken its engine with it. So, he’d need at least half a decade to build the tech, and there’s no way Larian would agree to licensing out its engine.
paragraphs.cn: 既然如此，又该如何接棒《博德之门3》呢？Ohlen显然看不到前路。他说自己得从零开始，因为Larian已经与《龙与地下城》分道扬镳，还带走了自家的引擎。因此他至少需要五年时间去构建相关技术，而Larian绝不可能同意向外授权自己的引擎。

paragraphs.en: Then there’s Larian boss Swen Vincke to contend with. He’s the CEO of the company and the majority shareholder, but he’s also the director of Baldur’s Gate 3, which means he is free to make creative decisions — for better and for worse. Most triple-A studio CEOs do not have such freedom or control.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，还有Larian的老板Swen Vincke这一关要过。他既是公司CEO兼大股东，也是《博德之门3》的导演，这意味着他可以自由做出创意决策——无论是好是坏。大多数3A工作室的CEO并没有这样的自由度或掌控权。

paragraphs.en: "Swen's always going to be the master of building those kinds of things,” Ohlen said. “It's really hard to take him off that throne, just because of everything — the tools, institutional knowledge, team."
paragraphs.cn: 「Swen永远会是这种项目的大师，」Ohlen说道，「想把他从那个王座上拉下来真的很难，原因就在于工具、团队积累的经验以及整个团队。」
